title: Delete the dead pre-per-profile notification scheduling API in NotificationGateway/NotificationScheduler
why: WS5.per-profile replaced these with *ForProfile equivalents (per the 'H1 fix' comments elsewhere in the file); a repo-wide grep for non-declaration, non-test callers of all 9 methods returns nothing, confirming zero production callers. Yet they still compile and are still exercised by roughly 780 of notification_gateway_test.dart's 1415 lines plus the entirety of notification_scheduler_test.dart and notification_service_test.dart. A future edit that calls scheduler.schedule()/.cancel() instead of the *ForProfile variant -- same class, plausible-looking name -- would silently reintroduce H1 (two competing ID schemes per profile) with no compiler or test signal, since the dead path still 'works' and stays green in CI.
recommendation: Delete the 9 legacy methods and the singleton ID constants, delete/collapse the corresponding dead tests, and keep only the *ForProfile surface.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rn for the 9 legacy method names in lib/ returns zero results once removed.
notification_gateway_test.dart / notification_scheduler_test.dart / notification_service_test.dart shrink accordingly with no loss of coverage on the *ForProfile paths.
